{{Quote|'''Captain!''' They're bringing the fight to '''us'''. Only a '''N-class freighter''' by the sensors, so--|Slssk|<ref name="Star Wars (1977) 16">[[Star Wars (1977) 16|''Star Wars'' (1977) 16]]</ref>}}
The '''WUD-500''' was an outdated [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|CEC]] star yacht design, with features similar to the freighters of the [[YT-series/Legends|YT-series]]. It was also called an '''N-class freighter'''.

The Corporation intended to bring up a popular luxury craft besides their popular freighter designs. They, however, could never gain as much acceptance on the luxury market as the more famous-for-luxury corporation [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub]]. It measured 18.5 meters in length and could be operated without great difficulty by a single pilot. As for cargo-space, the WUD-500 had room enough for three metric tons of cargo, as well as being able to take seven passengers.

However, sole smugglers required such vessels, as it features excellent sublight engines and hyperdrive suite as well as a fair weapons complement for a ship of its size.

The smuggler [[Jaxxon/Legends|Jaxxon]] owned and modified a WUD-500 which he named [[Rabbit's Foot/Legends|''Rabbit's Foot'']].
